subject.title: fix(release): reuse evidence for changelog-only candidates

question: Should release managers approve reviewed changelog-only impact policies as authority to reuse selected beta release evidence across candidate SHAs?
rationale: The implementation can establish evidence identity and fail closed, but maintainers must own the semantic release-policy claim that each reused gate is unaffected by the metadata-only delta.

options.title: Approve strict beta-only v1
options.body: Adopt the workflow after the reader lands, the concrete policy is reviewed, and successful exact-head integrated proof is recorded.

options.title: Keep every gate fresh
options.body: Decline policy-based cross-SHA reuse and continue rerunning the broad release matrix after every candidate SHA change.

recommendation.title: Approve strict beta-only v1
recommendation.body: Adopt the workflow after the reader lands, the concrete policy is reviewed, and successful exact-head integrated proof is recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history-backed ownership of the canonical release validation, evidence, and publication trust boundaries affected by this decision.
